jobPostingInfo.title: Customer Success Manager, International Public Sector
jobPostingInfo.jobDescription:
See yourself at Acme

Acme is seeking a self-motivated Customer Success Manager who excels at building deep, meaningful relationships with customers at every level of an organisation: the operational (user) level, with the team leads who own the problem sets this role helps solve, and with key decision-makers. As a natural customer advocate and platform specialist, you listen, understand, and define customer operational needs with our software solutions, developing customer trust and understanding to the point where Acme Customer Success feels like a true mission partner to our EMEA clients. Your goal is to lead client engagements across the UK, Nordic, and wider European Public Sector (spanning Central Government, National Security, International Defence, and wider public safety and policing). Through tailored training, usage assessments, and executive business reviews, you will help customers get maximum value from our platforms while guiding them through our evolving product suite, advanced AI capabilities, data feeds, and partner integrations. You have a strong grasp of service culture, modern SaaS platforms, and account management tools, and you are excited to help transform how Public Sector and Defence clients use real-time intelligence in their daily operations.

AI Innovation at Acme 

Working at Acme you’ll have the opportunity to tackle the most exciting trends in AI on a daily basis to power a revolutionary product that uncovers critical events around the world as they unfold.

Regenerative AI: our AI technology, Acme, is a new form of generative AI that automatically regenerates real-time Live Event Briefs as events unfold. Learn more here.

Agentic AI: we recently launched our Agentic AI capability, what we’re calling our Intel Agents, that autonomously generates critical context for our clients on real-time events, threats, and risks allowing them to see the clearest, most accurate view of what’s happening on the ground. Learn more here

Multimodal AI: our platform detects events from many different types of data (images, video, sensor data, audio, and text in over 150 languages). Learn more here. 

The opportunity

  • Master the Product Line-up: Serve as a knowledgeable expert across Acme's platforms, developing a strong command of our evolving AI capabilities and publicly available information (PAI) use cases.
  • Embed Acme in Customer Workflows: Understand each customer's structure, mission priorities, and operational processes to design and deliver onboarding and adoption programmes that make Acme an essential part of their daily workflow, whether through our web and mobile platforms or alongside their existing operational tools (such as mapping or common operating picture platforms).
  • Drive Retention & Account Growth: Build trusted, multi-tiered relationships from watchfloor operators and team leads up to key decision-makers, partnering closely with Account Executives and Solutions Engineers across your regional pod to drive high customer retention, support upgrades across our platforms, and identify opportunities to expand Acme into new teams or integrations.
  • Deliver High-Impact Customer Reviews: Conduct regular, data-driven Executive Business Reviews (EBRs), user training sessions, and success planning to demonstrate operational value, address adoption gaps early, and uncover new use cases.
  • Optimise Platform Configuration: Build tailored alerting profiles and advanced search logic for customers, monitor usage trends, and spot opportunities where customers relying on manual processes could benefit from our automated feeds or partner connectors.
  • Act as the Voice of the Customer: Capture structured customer feedback on our platforms and new AI features, working closely with Solutions Engineering, Technical Support, and Product teams to ensure customer needs are understood and addressed.

What you bring

At Acme, we value you for who you are. We encourage you to apply for this role, even if you don't meet every qualification. Our candidates are reviewed on the basis of their skill and potential to succeed.

  • Public Sector & Defence Experience: Experience working within or supporting UK, Nordic, or European Central Government, National Security, or International/NATO Defence organisations, with a practical understanding of publicly available information (PAI), OSINT, or threat and risk intelligence workflows.
  • Customer Success & Relationship Track Record: Bachelor's degree or equivalent operational, civil service, or military experience, plus at least 3 to 5 years of customer success, account management, or client-facing onboarding experience. You have a proven ability to build deep trust and credibility across all stakeholder tiers, from frontline operational users and problem-owning team leads to key decision-makers, positioning yourself as a true mission partner.
  • Modern SaaS & Product Aptitude: A genuinely tech-savvy mindset with the confidence to learn and demonstrate new AI features quickly. While this is not a hands-on engineering role, you should be comfortable discussing how SaaS platforms, data feeds (APIs), and third-party software integrations fit into a customer's wider operational environment, and collaborating with Solutions Engineers when deeper technical scoping is required.
  • Analytical & Problem-Solving Skills: Strong analytical approach with the ability to build complex Boolean search queries, interpret customer usage data to tell a clear value story, and translate new platform capabilities into straightforward operational benefits for frontline users and senior leadership alike.
  • Operational Discipline & Communication: Detail-oriented with strong organisation, CRM hygiene (e.g., Salesforce, Gainsight), and the ability to manage a varied portfolio of accounts with high accountability in a fast-paced environment. Full professional fluency in English is essential; proficiency in Danish or another Nordic language is a strong advantage.
  • Clearance & Travel: Must hold (or be eligible and willing to obtain) relevant National Security Vetting (e.g. UKSV, Danish security clearance, or NATO equivalent) to work across government and defence accounts, and be willing to travel domestically and internationally across EMEA as required (approximately 35% to 45% of the time).

#LI-WC1

jobPostingInfo.title: Product Manager III, Cybersecurity Integrations
jobPostingInfo.jobDescription:
See yourself at Acme

At Acme, you will drive the creation of high-impact, mission critical cybersecurity product integrations as a Product Manager, Cybersecurity Integrations. This role is responsible for defining and executing integrations across our entire cybersecurity product portfolio and with a wide array of partner solutions. Everyday, our clients rely on these integrations to exchange real-time alerts, critical threat intelligence, indicators, asset data, and more with other top-tier industry tools. Collaborating with world class engineers and partner companies, you will transform conceptual ideas into new or enhanced integrations. We are looking for a builder who excels in a dynamic, high-velocity environment—an individual equally skilled at guiding high-level product strategy and deep-diving into complex partner API specifications. This US-based position offers the flexibility of remote work or can be located in our New York office

AI Innovation at Acme 

Working at Acme you’ll have the opportunity to tackle the most exciting trends in AI on a daily basis to power a revolutionary product that uncovers critical events around the world as they unfold.

Agentic AI: we recently launched our Agentic AI capability, what we’re calling our Intel Agents, that autonomously generates critical context for our clients on real-time events, threats, and risks allowing them to see the clearest, most accurate view of what’s happening on the ground. Learn more here

Multimodal AI: our platform detects events from many different types of data (images, video, sensor data, audio, and text in over 150 languages). Learn more here.

The opportunity

  • Build solutions that scale. Lead the ideation, research, and validation of new product capabilities, turning novel concepts into highly valuable cybersecurity product integrations.
  • Lead execution from concept to launch. Partner with a world-class engineering team to define requirements, manage the product lifecycle, and deliver products that exceed customer expectations.
  • Collaborate and win. Work closely with sales, marketing, customer success, and partner teams to develop go-to-market strategies, create compelling enablement materials, and drive product adoption and growth.

What you bring

At Acme, we value you for who you are. We encourage you to apply for this role, even if you don't meet every qualification. Our candidates are reviewed on the basis of their skill and potential to succeed.

  • Experience in cybersecurity, either as a practitioner or someone who has built cybersecurity products (in Product Management or Engineering).
  • Experience using or creating cybersecurity APIs. Experience using Postman, or other tools, to use APIs and analyze their output.
  • Ideally you understand and have built integrations for popular cybersecurity solutions, such as SIEMs, SOARs, threat intelligence feeds, TIPs, EDRs, XDRs, vulnerability management, or others.
  • Ideally you have experience using Claude Cowork, Claude Code, and/or Google Gemini.
  • A strategic thinker who can define a compelling product vision and roadmap, translating complex ideas into actionable plans and measurable business results.
  • A technical builder who understands the architecture of SaaS and on-prem platforms and is comfortable defining functional specifications for cybersecurity product integrations.
  • An exceptional communicator and leader with excellent organizational, written, and oral skills who can inspire and lead cross-functional teams and present to senior leadership.
  • Analytical and action-oriented, you break down complex problems, use data to drive decisions, and are resilient, resourceful, and relentless in your pursuit of product excellence.

You have experience managing complex software solutions, multiple client stakeholders, and proactive account strategy. You leverage your consultative skills to identify customer needs to build long-term solutions that ensure strong retention outcomes along with opportunistic growth opportunities.

This role is based hybrid (NYC area) or hybrid (Northern VA/DC area)

  • Detail-oriented with excellent organizational skills and a strong focus on delivering the best possible client experience
  • Knowledge and/or experience of publicly available information and social media analysis efforts of or enterprise organizations, including but not limited to corporate security, risk, or crisis management a plus

Acme is seeking an Account Executive to sell our Physical Security solutions to high-profile US SLED accounts and ensure that Acme’s critical alerts are getting into the right hands at the right time. You'll deliver unique and impactful solutions to your SLED clients while exceeding quotas and establishing strong customer relationships, while working closely with a variety of channel partners.

This is a NY/NJ US-based remote role and as such we are looking for candidates in the territory

  • Build a pipeline, leverage partners and network: Build a strong pipeline through proactive prospecting, strategic networking, and leveraging our growing list of partners
  • Cultivate strong client relationships: Cultivate and sustain valuable client relationships whilst skilfully navigating and closing complex enterprise deals
  • Develop deep customer insights: Develop comprehensive insights into customer use cases, internal decision-making processes, budget cycles, and other critical information
  • Master competitive analysis: Analyze the competitive landscape and understand customer needs in order to position Acme’s portfolio of solutions effectively to meet customer needs and stand out from the competition
  • Provide product feedback: Provide valuable feedback to cross-functional teams (Product, Engineering) to drive the continuous enhancement, updates and improvements of our products

What you bring

At Acme, we value you for who you are. We encourage you to apply for this role, even if you don't meet every qualification. Our candidates are reviewed on the basis of their skill and potential to succeed.

  • A hunter by nature, with expertise in  prospecting via a multi-channel approach including cold calling, channel partner relationships, LinkedIn outreach and networking

  • A strategic seller, with expertise in account planning, you use a clear sales process (MEDDPICC preferred) to qualify and move deals through the pipeline to close
  • A history of consistent quota achievement and ability to deliver consistently against targets
